concept.title: People affected by dementia
concept.shortdesc: People living with dementia or memory problems, including those without a diagnosis, and the family and carers who support them.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Family members and other carers looking after someone with dementia, including sessions for the person and their carer together.
: People with a diagnosis of dementia or Alzheimer's, and dementia-friendly groups.
: People with memory loss, memory concerns or dementia, including those worried about their memory and without a diagnosis.
